title: Live coding without freezing, and thinking out loud

videos.script: A live exercise is a small problem solved while somebody watches: a function in a shared editor, a query, or a broken machine in a lab. {{what}} The problem is usually easy. What makes people freeze is being watched, and the silence that follows. {{freeze}} The interviewer is not only checking whether you reach the answer. They are checking how you get there, and they can only see that if you say it. {{how}} This lesson gives the exercise a shape, deals with what to do when you are stuck, and ends with how to practise the one thing that practice improves the most.
